🛠️ How This App Works

Insta-PayTrack helps you manage monthly payment collection for your internet customers efficiently.

📋
Contact Management
View all customers with pending/cleared status at a glance
💰
Payment Recording
Tap Pay to record payments instantly. Amount auto-updates
🚀
Blast Messaging
Send WhatsApp reminders to all pending contacts by date group
🌐
Sync
Two sheets — Online users and Sunny's offline users kept separate
📥
Excel Export
Export updated data to Excel file at end of day
🔔
Reminders
Set follow-up reminders for specific customers with notes
🔍
Smart Filters
Filter by date (1st, 5th, 10th...), sheet type, or payment status
📱
Install as App
Open in Chrome → Menu → Add to Home Screen for app-like experience
📱 Install as Mobile App

1. Send this file to yourself on WhatsApp
2. Open in Chrome on your phone
3. Tap Chrome menu (⋮) → Add to Home screen
4. Confirm Add — Done! 🎉

The app works offline and saves all data on your phone automatically.

✏️ Edit Contact

Update any field below
Payment Status: Pending
Toggle ON = mark as Paid (pending = 0). Toggle OFF = mark as Unpaid (restores monthly bill as pending). Ghalti se paid ho gaya? OFF karo — dubara unpaid ho jaye ga.
